This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

Milwaukee M18 BSX-0 cordless Sawzall reciprocating saw features a high performance, 4-pole motor that delivers maximum power whilst maximising the power to weight ratio. The robust, extremely fast-cutting 18V reciprocating saw is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and demolition tasks on site, making light work of demanding cuts in wood and steel. Also features a counterbalance mechanism, reducing vibrations to 15.2 m/s² in wooden beams, to enhance user comfort and control. RedLink overload protection and constant speed electronics deliver excellent durability and consistent performance for trade professionals. Battery and charger sold separately.
